title: 9 Things a Godly Man Stops Calling a Phase
caption:
"It's just a phase." "I'm just blowing off steam." "I'm just figuring things out."

Every sin a man refuses to kill gets a softer name first. That's not an accident. Renaming it is how you keep it around without having to feel like the guy who's still doing it.

Scripture never says manage your sin. It says put it to death (Colossians 3:5). Not next phase. Not when it's convenient. Now, while it's still small enough to name honestly.

Save this and read it again on the day you catch yourself reaching for one of these lines.
